notes.server: Express app in server/src/app.js. PORT defaults to 5000 (env.port). All module routes are mounted under /api/v1 via server/src/routes/index.js.
notes.envelope: Every handler responds through utils/response.js. Success = { success: true, data: <payload> }. Error = { success: false, error: { message, type, code } }.
notes.auth: JWT HS256 signed with JWT_SECRET. Access token expires in 1d, refresh token in 7d. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. middlewares/auth.middleware.js re-checks the user still exists and is_active on every request.
notes.roles: super_admin inherits admin (constants/roles.js). Any gate listing 'admin' also accepts 'super_admin'.
notes.validation: Joi via middlewares/validate.middleware.js with stripUnknown:true and allowUnknown:false — unknown body/query keys are stripped, schema violations return 400.
notes.rate_limits: Global: 100 requests / 15 min per IP. Login routes (/auth/login/*, /auth/login): 5 requests / 15 min per IP.
notes.cors: Origin restricted to env FRONTEND_URL (default http://localhost:3000).

endpoints.name: Login (admin portal)
endpoints.description: Authenticates an admin or super_admin. Rejects any other role with a generic 'Invalid credentials' 401. Rate limited to 5 attempts / 15 min per IP.

endpoints.name: Login (student portal)
endpoints.description: Authenticates a student. Initial password is the student's roll_number until the one-time reset is performed. Rate limited to 5 attempts / 15 min per IP.

endpoints.name: Login (teacher portal)
endpoints.description: Authenticates a teacher. Initial password is the teacher's employee_id until the one-time reset is performed. Rate limited to 5 attempts / 15 min per IP.

endpoints.name: Unified login (mobile / web)
endpoints.description: Role-agnostic login used by the mobile client. Returns both an access token and a refresh token. Rate limited to 5 attempts / 15 min per IP.

endpoints.name: Refresh access token
endpoints.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair. The token must carry type='refresh'. A missing or non-string refreshToken is rejected with 400; a syntactically valid but expired/invalid token is 401.

endpoints.name: Refresh access token (mobile alias)
endpoints.description: Alias of POST /auth/refresh-token; the mobile client is configured to call this path. Same controller (refreshUnified) and same validation.

endpoints.name: Logout
endpoints.description: Stateless acknowledgement — no server-side token revocation is performed. The client is expected to discard its tokens.

endpoints.name: One-time password reset
endpoints.description: Students and teachers only. Allowed exactly once — fails with 403 if users.password_changed is already true. Admins are rejected with 403.

endpoints.name: Set password (mobile alias)
endpoints.description: Same one-time reset as /auth/reset-password. Accepts either 'newPassword' or 'password' (newPassword wins); at least one is required and both are held to the same strength rule as /auth/reset-password.

endpoints.name: Current authenticated profile (auth module)

endpoints.name: Current authenticated profile (user module)
endpoints.description: Role-shaped self profile. Students get academic + guardian data, teachers get { name, employeeId, departmentId, personal }, admins get { name, adminId, departmentId, departmentName, personal }.

endpoints.name: Create user (+ role profile)
endpoints.description: Admin / super_admin only. Creates the users row and the matching student, teacher or admin profile row in one transaction. Only a super_admin may create admin or super_admin accounts. Conditional fields: roll_number/batch are required-or-forbidden by role=student, employee_id by role=teacher, admin_id by role=admin|super_admin; department_id is required for all four roles.

endpoints.name: List users
endpoints.description: Admin / super_admin only. Returns every user with password_hash excluded. Not paginated.

endpoints.name: Get user by id
endpoints.description: Admin / super_admin only. 404 if the user does not exist.

endpoints.name: Update user
endpoints.description: Admin / super_admin only. At least one field required. 'role' may only be set to admin, student or teacher (super_admin is not assignable here). A supplied password is bcrypt-hashed with cost 12. 409 if the email is taken.

endpoints.name: Deactivate user (soft delete)
endpoints.description: Admin / super_admin only. Soft delete — sets is_active = false rather than removing the row.

endpoints.description: Student role only. Returns the raw students row for the authenticated user. 404 if no student profile exists.

endpoints.name: Update teacher profile

endpoints.description: Admin only. At least one field required. Re-checks capacity when the change consumes a new seat, and 409s on duplicate student/offering pairs. status is one of 'enrolled' | 'dropped'.

endpoints.name: Delete enrollment
endpoints.description: Admin only. Hard delete; returns the deleted row. 404 if not found.

endpoints.name: Create weekly schedule slot
endpoints.description: Admin or teacher (teachers only for offerings they own). 409 if the new slot overlaps an existing slot for the same offering on the same day. The whole schedule router is also mounted at /api/v1/classes, so every /schedules/* path below is reachable at the identical /classes/* path.

endpoints.name: List schedule slots for an offering
endpoints.description: Any authenticated user, but the service asserts the caller has access to the offering (teachers must own it; students must be enrolled). Also reachable at /api/v1/classes/offering/:offeringId.

endpoints.description: Student role only. Without ?date returns the weekly timetable grouped by day. With ?date=YYYY-MM-DD returns a flat, exception-resolved list of that day's classes (cancellations, reschedules and extra classes applied). 'date' must match YYYY-MM-DD (validated as a string, since the service splits it on '-'); a malformed value is rejected with 400 rather than silently returning an empty list. Also reachable at /api/v1/classes.

query_parameters.date: string (optional, YYYY-MM-DD) - resolve a single day's classes instead of the weekly grid

endpoints.name: Delete schedule exception
endpoints.description: Admin or teacher (owned offerings only). 404 if the exception does not exist. Declared before DELETE /:id so it wins the route match. Also reachable at /api/v1/classes/exceptions/:id.

endpoints.name: Delete schedule slot
endpoints.description: Admin or teacher (owned offerings only). 404 if the schedule does not exist. Also reachable at /api/v1/classes/:id.

endpoints.name: My attendance summary

endpoints.name: Record attendance (exception-based marking)
endpoints.description: Admin or teacher (owned offerings only). Body must supply EXACTLY ONE of offering_id or session_id (Joi .xor), and offering_id additionally REQUIRES date (Joi .with). Every actively-enrolled student is defaulted to 'present'; 'records' only needs the exceptions (absent/late/leave). Passing a student_id that is not actively enrolled returns 400. status values: present | absent | late | leave.

endpoints.description: Admin or teacher (owned offerings only). Upserts on (offering_id, date) — calling it twice for the same date returns the existing session with schedule_id/exception_id merged.

endpoints.description: Student role only. Session-by-session history for the authenticated student in the given offering. Sessions with no explicit record default to 'present'.

endpoints.description: Student role only. Every assignment across the student's active enrollments, with submission progress and grade merged in. A 'pending' item whose due date has passed is reported as 'overdue'.

query_parameters.status: string (optional) - one of 'pending' | 'done' | 'overdue'; filters the result list

For assessment_type in (assignment, quiz, presentation, project) a reference_id pointing at an assignment in the same offering is REQUIRED, and title/max_score are overwritten from that assignment; for the other types (sessional, midterm, final, practical) title and max_score are required in the body. Upserts on (enrollment_id, reference_id) or (enrollment_id, assessment_type).

endpoints.name: List grades for an offering

endpoints.name: Calculate weighted course grade
endpoints.description: Admin, teacher (owned offerings only) or student. A student may only request their own studentId — anything else is 403. Applies the offering's mid/sessional/final/practical weights, then rounds up (Math.ceil) to the final marks and maps to a letter grade and grade point.
